userFeedback: The finial flute overlays were gone, but the rear half of the open copper torus remained visible and made the top appear transparent.

reviews.notes: All eight reddish copper FinialFlute capsule objects have been removed; the export contains zero nodes with that name.
Eight shallow radial channels are sculpted into the closed limestone finial vertex surface instead of being placed above it.
The finial remains one continuous limestone piece; copper is restricted to the intentional collar below it.
The corrected asset remains at five materials, eight LOD0 draw calls, three colliders, and strictly decreasing LOD counts with zero degenerate faces or loose vertices.
